home.name: Pompon Citadel
home.description: The heart of your realm. Recruit, build, and plan your next adventures.

gold.name: Golden honey mine
gold.description: Capture the mine: +150 gold each day.

crystal.name: Crystal garden
crystal.description: Capture the garden: +3 crystals each day.

spring.name: Whispering spring
spring.description: An enchanted spring restores your mana and heals your whole army.

camp1.name: Forgotten clearing
camp1.description: Lost creatures guard a treasure. Victory: 450 gold, 6 crystals, +55 XP.

camp2.name: Dawn ruins
camp2.description: A seasoned troop defends these ruins. Victory: 700 gold, 10 crystals, +75 XP.

shade-castle.name: Mists Castle
shade-castle.description: An enemy garrison holds the walls. Siege it to conquer: +150 gold per day and local recruitment.

dawn-castle.name: Dawn Castle
dawn-castle.description: Dusk towers loom over the valley. Conquer this fortress: +150 gold per day and local recruitment.

army1.name: The Bramble Band
army1.description: An enemy army blocks the path. Reach their tile to fight: 450 gold, 6 crystals, and 55 XP.

army2.name: Dusk Guard
army2.description: Evolved creatures hold the pass. Defeat this army: 700 gold, 10 crystals, and 75 XP.

boss.name: Dusk Fortress
boss.description: Defeat the Lord of Dusk after both camps to bring light back to the realm.

sylve.name: Beardmoss
sylve.description: A small guardian with a green beard. Roots slow the target after each attack.

sylve-guard.name: Wood warden
sylve-guard.description: Leaf armor and an oak heart. Reduces damage taken by 25%.

sylve-druid.name: Emerald druid
sylve-druid.description: A glowing beard channels the forest. Recovers HP after each attack.

sylve-ancient.name: Sylve ancestor
sylve-ancient.description: Majestic woods, ancient magic. A mighty guardian that can regenerate.

sol.name: Sun plush
sol.description: A yellow crest crackles with magic. Fires sparks in battle, with a penalty at long range.

sol-flame.name: Ember crest
sol-flame.description: A blazing crest and stronger sparks. Attacks deal 20% extra damage.

sol-star.name: Star oracle
sol-star.description: Reads the constellations and absorbs light. Attacks restore some HP.

sol-phoenix.name: Dawn phoenix
sol-phoenix.description: Crowned with feathers and golden wings. The ultimate sun plush form.
